findings.evidence: Lines 76-84 of the new file vs `theorem Convex.affine_preimage (f : E →ᵃ[𝕜] F) {s : Set F} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) : Convex 𝕜 (f ⁻¹' s)` at mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Convex/Basic.lean:455.
findings.fix: Replace the hand proof by `((convex_ball z₀ ε).translate_preimage_left _).linear_preimage ((LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ _ b).restrictScalars ℝ)` (or build the line as an `AffineMap` and apply `Convex.affine_preimage`), so the step is one library invocation rather than a re-derivation.
findings.issue: `hS : Convex ℝ S` re-proves, by hand over nine lines (`intro a ha b hb s t ...`, `funext`, `simp only [p, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, real_smul]`, `linear_combination`), the fact that the preimage of a convex set under the affine line `c ↦ u + c • v` is convex. Mathlib already has it (`Convex.affine_preimage`, Mathlib/Analysis/Convex/Basic.lean:455; `Convex.linear_preimage` :184; `Convex.translate_preimage_left` :239), and the explicit simp-lemma list (`real_smul`, `Pi.smul_apply`, …) is exactly the kind of chain that breaks on upstream renames.

findings.evidence: Lines 98-100; the statement mentions only `Complex.ofReal` and `𝓝[≠]`, no reference to `f`, `p`, `S` or the ball.
findings.fix: Lift it to a `private` lemma next to the aux theorem (e.g. `Tendsto (ofReal : ℝ → ℂ) (𝓝[≠] x) (𝓝[≠] (x : ℂ))`), proved once from injectivity of `ofReal` plus continuity, and apply it here. Pulling this and the convexity step out also brings the aux proof under the 50-line mark.
findings.issue: Same pattern, second instance: `ht : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝[≠] 0)` is a general, reusable statement about `Complex.ofReal` and punctured neighbourhoods, proved inline inside the 54-line proof via an unfolding-heavy `simpa using continuous_ofReal.continuousWithinAt.tendsto_nhdsWithin … (by simpa using hs)`; it has nothing to do with the analytic argument around it.

summary: Proofs are generally readable and automation-based, with no change/show and no undocumented defeq. The one >50-line proof (`eventuallyEq_zero_of_eventuallyEq_zero_ofReal_aux`, 54 lines) buries two self-contained general facts inline, one of which re-derives an existing Mathlib lemma through a brittle named-lemma list.
